text:
Type: small kids rug with a house print
Use: playing and sitting on the floor, bedside mat; kids room, nursery, playroom
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: short low pile fabric with a printed pattern
Colors: bright sky blue, black, white
Shape: small rectangle with a hand-drawn house front, window and door below, black and white vertical stripes above, thin dark border, flat
Feel: playful, cheerful, graphic
Goes with: white kids furniture, primary colors, black and white accents; children's rooms and playrooms

product.name: HEMMAHOS
product.description: If you combine many rugs you can create a colourful street with its own zebra crossing.
